### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the Mistral finish-reason normalization change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR aligns Mistral’s context-length handling with other providers by mapping `model_length` to `context_window` in the shared Chat Completions provider. **Changes:** - Enables existing truncation warnings and structured-output errors for Mistral’s `model_length` finish reason. - Adds regression tests for normalization and structured-output error handling. - Documents the fix in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_provider_openai_completions.py` | Tests finish-reason mapping and context-window error handling. | | `chatlas/​_provider_openai_completions.py` | Maps `model_length` to `context_window`. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Describes the corrected Mistral truncation behavior. |
Review effort: Balanced
